B2B Community Manager Job at Outsource Point Limited




        
    

        
        Outsource Point Limited - Our client, a reputable company in the Fintech sector, is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: B2B Community Manager

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	As the B2B Community Manager, you will build and manage an active business community comprising SMEs, startups, founders, finance teams, agencies, and strategic partners.
	You will design community-led initiatives that strengthen customer relationships, increase product adoption, improve retention, and generate valuable insights for business growth._


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Develop and execute a B2B community strategy across LinkedIn, Slack, Telegram, and other relevant platforms
	Plan webinars, workshops, networking sessions, and community events that support customer education and product adoption
	Identify and nurture community ambassadors, strategic partners, and power users who can strengthen brand advocacy
	Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to address customer needs and improve the user experience
	Track member acquisition, engagement, retention, event participation, and the commercial impact of community initiatives.


Requirements


	 Interested candidates should possess an HND / Bachelor’s Degree
	1 - 3 years of experience managing a B2B, startup, professional, or customer-focused community
	Demonstrable experience growing an engaged community and delivering measurable outcomes
	Practical knowledge of CRM, email marketing, and community platforms such as HubSpot, Slack, Telegram, or similar tools
	Strong understanding of the Nigerian startup, SME, technology, or fintech ecosystem
	Excellent relationship-building, public speaking, event coordination, and stakeholder engagement skills.


Salary
N250,000 - N400,000 monthly.

HR Manager Job at Outsource Point Limited




        
    

        
        
     

            
    

Outsource Point Limited - Our client, a reputable company in the Fintech sector, is recruiting to fill the position below:



Job Position: HR Manager 
Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

 



Job Summary


	As the HR Manager, you will manage core people operations and partner with business leaders to improve employee performance, engagement, and workplace culture.
	You will coordinate performance reviews, employee relations, talent development, HR compliance, onboarding, and retention initiatives for a growing workforce.


Responsibilities


	Coordinate performance reviews, development plans, career-management processes, and employee-engagement programmes
	Support managers in addressing performance gaps, workplace conflicts, disciplinary matters, and employee-development needs
	Manage HR operations, employee documentation, policy implementation, onboarding, and retention activities
	Analyze workforce data and provide practical recommendations on engagement, performance, turnover, and people risks
	Ensure HR practices comply with Nigerian labour laws, company policies, and established employee-relations procedures


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related discipline; CIPM certification is an advantage
	2–5 years of experience covering HR operations, employee engagement, performance management, and employee relations Experience working in a fintech, technology, startup, or other fast-paced organization is an advantage
	Strong understanding of Nigerian labour laws and the ability to manage sensitive employee matters professionally
	Excellent communication, stakeholder management, data interpretation, problem-solving, and execution skills.




Salary
N350,000 - N500,000 per

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Supply Manager",
  "description": "The Alliance for International Medical Action (ALIMA) is an independent humanitarian medical NGO that was created in 2009 by professionals of humanitarian medicine. ALIMA&rsquo;s mission is to provide medical care in emergency situations or medical catastrophes.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Supply Manager

Job Location: Abuja
Job Type: Full time

Mission Objectives


	The Supply Manager in collaboration of logistic Coordinator is responsible for the proper designing, planning, and implementation of the supply chain in the mission/country, ensuring the achievement of the objectives set at the mission Level.
	To Support Country Mission, in ensuring timely arrangement of different project commodities i.e. goods, drugs, and services to Support ALIMA intervention in North EAST Nigeria.
	Ensure Supply support to the mission in Coherence of ALIMA standard Procurement procedures &amp; Donor Financial requirements.
	Understand the Nigerian Government customs &amp; import procedures, IDEC &amp; NAFDAC procedures and insure our supply strategies are aligned accordingly.


Responsibilites

Team Management:

	Evacuation of the employee.





Conditions

title: Job Openings at Marsand Bespoke Joinery
content:
Marsand Bespoke Joinery specializes in creating high-quality, custom-made joinery solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of each client. With a commitment to craftsmanship and attention to detail, they offer a wide range of services, including bespoke cabinetry, furniture, and architectural joinery. Their team of skilled artisans combines traditional woodworking techniques with modern technology to deliver exceptional products that enhance both functionality and aesthetics in residential and commercial spaces.
     

            
    



Marsand prides itself on its personalized service, working closely with clients to understand their vision and bring it to life. Whether it’s a stunning kitchen renovation, a unique piece of furniture, or intricate woodwork for a commercial project, they ensure that every piece reflects the client's style and requirements. Their dedication to sustainability and using responsibly sourced materials further sets them apart in the joinery industry.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Company Architect (Fully Fitted Wardrobes / Kitchen)

Job Location: Awoyaya, Sangotedo - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Meet with clients to understand project goals, requirements, and budget.
	Develop architectural concepts, sketches, and detailed design plans.
	Prepare construction drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
	Ensure designs comply with local building codes, zoning laws, and safety regulations.
	Coordinate with structural, mechanical, electrical, and civil engineers.
	Review project feasibility, site conditions, and environmental impacts.
	Manage project timelines, budgets, and resources.
	Monitor construction progress and conduct site inspections to ensure quality and compliance.
	Address design changes and resolve technical issues during construction.
	Present design proposals to clients, stakeholders, and regulatory authorities.


Salary
N200,000 - N300,000 per month.

Application Closing Date: 30th August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Carpenter

Job Location: Awoyaya, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are looking for a skilled, dedicated, and experienced Carpenter to join our growing team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for manufacturing, assembling, installing, and finishing high-quality bespoke furniture and joinery products.
	This role requires excellent craftsmanship, attention to detail, and the ability to produce work to the highest standards while meeting project deadlines.


Key Duties


	Furniture manufacturing.
	Cabinet assembly.
	Kitchen and wardrobe production.
	Furniture installation.
	Workshop maintenance.
	Site installation and finishing.
	Material preparation.
	Machine operation.
	Quality control.
	Customer service during installations.


Key Responsibilities


	Manufacture bespoke furniture, including kitchens, wardrobes, TV units, cabinets, office furniture, and other custom joinery products.
	Read and interpret technical drawings, production drawings, and specifications accurately.
	Measure, mark, cut, assemble, and install wood and other materials with precision.
	Generate and work from cut lists to ensure efficient material usage.
	Operate woodworking machinery and hand tools safely and efficiently.
	Carry out edge banding, drilling, routing, sanding, assembly, and finishing of furniture.
	Install completed furniture at customer sites to a professional standard.
	Conduct quality checks throughout production and installation.
	Carry out repairs, adjustments, and maintenance when required.
	Work closely with the design, production, and installation teams to ensure projects are delivered on time.
	Maintain a clean, organised, and safe workshop environment.
	Ensure all work complies with company quality and health & safety standards.


Health & Safety Responsibilities:


	Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times.
	Operate machinery and tools safely and in accordance with company procedures.
	Report faults, hazards, accidents, or near misses immediately.
	Keep the workshop and work areas clean, tidy, and free from hazards.
	Follow all company health and safety policies and safe working practices.


Working Hours:


	Monday to Friday: 9:00am – 6:00pm.
	Saturday: As required for installations, factory production, or project deadlines.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Produce high-quality furniture that meets company standards.
	Complete projects within agreed deadlines.
	Maintain accuracy when working from technical drawings and cut lists.
	Minimise material waste and maximise efficiency.
	Achieve high customer satisfaction during installations.
	Maintain excellent housekeeping and workshop organisation.
	Comply with all company health and safety procedures.


Skills and Experience


	Proven experience as a Carpenter, Cabinet Maker, Joiner, or Furniture Maker.
	Ability to manufacture and install bespoke furniture.
	Experience using woodworking machinery such as panel saws, edge banders, routers, drills, planers, and sanders.
	Ability to read technical drawings and production plans.
	Good knowledge of furniture fittings, hardware, and installation techniques.
	Strong measuring and mathematical skills.
	Excellent attention to detail.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Good communication and problem-solving skills.


Personal Attributes:


	Honest and trustworthy.
	Reliable and punctual.
	Strong work ethic.
	Excellent attention to detail.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
	Professional appearance and conduct.
	Team player with excellent communication skills.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 per month.

Application Closing Date: 14th August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

3.) Social Media Content Creator

Job Location: Awoyaya, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Create original and engaging content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other digital platforms.
	Capture high-quality photos and videos of furniture projects, customer installations, showroom displays, factory production, and carpentry training sessions.
	Edit videos into professional reels, short-form videos, promotional adverts, and behind-the-scenes content.
	Write compelling captions, headlines, and calls-to-action that encourage audience engagement.
	Plan and maintain a monthly content calendar aligned with company campaigns and marketing objectives.
	Attend site visits, installations, exhibitions, and factory operations to capture live content.
	Produce creative promotional videos for products, services, and training programmes.
	Work closely with the Marketing and Sales teams to develop content that generates enquiries and sales.
	Keep up to date with current social media trends, viral content, and platform updates.
	Respond to comments, direct messages, and social media enquiries where required.
	Ensure all content reflects the Marsand Bespoke Limited brand identity and maintains a professional image.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Deliver high-quality content consistently.
	Increase social media engagement and follower growth.
	Generate qualified enquiries through digital content.
	Meet agreed content production deadlines.
	Improve brand visibility and online presence.
	Support marketing campaigns that contribute to sales growth.
	Maintain a consistent posting schedule across all platforms.


Content Expectations
The successful candidate will be expected to create: 

MultimediaSoftware


	Product showcase videos.
	Furniture installation videos.
	Customer testimonial videos.
	Workshop and factory behind-the-scenes content.
	Educational carpentry tips and tutorials.
	Student training and graduation highlights.
	Promotional adverts and campaign videos.
	Before-and-after transformation videos.
	Staff spotlight and company culture content.
	Event coverage and exhibition highlights.


Skills and Experience


	Proven experience as a Social Media Content Creator, Digital Content Creator, or similar role.
	Excellent photography and videography skills.
	Strong video editing skills using tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar software.
	Experience using Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or other design applications.
	Strong copywriting and storytelling abilities.
	Good understanding of social media algorithms, trends, and audience engagement.
	Ability to work independently while managing multiple projects and deadlines.
	Creative mindset with excellent attention to detail.


Working Hours:


	Monday to Friday: 9:00am – 6:00pm
	Occasional Saturday work may be required for site visits, factory visits, exhibitions, or special events.


Personal Attributes:


	Highly creative and innovative.
	Passionate about digital media and content creation.
	Self-motivated and proactive.
	Strong communication and organisational skills.
	Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Professional, reliable, and detail-oriented.
	Willing to travel for site visits and content capture when required.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 per month.

Application Closing Date: 17th August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "description": "Prestigious Consulting is a professional HR consultancy firm. We focus on improving organizational performance through strategic people &amp; process management.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Growth Manager

Job Location: Remote

Summary


	We&#39;re hiring a Growth Manager to own customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth from theground up.
	This is a hands-on, individual contributor to builder role: you&#39;ll design and run the growth strategy, then build out the team and processes to scale it as the company grows.


Job Responsibilities


	Own the end to end growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue expansion.
	Design, launch, and iterate on growth experiments (paid, lifecycle, referral, partnerships, content) using a test and learn approach.
	Define and track the core growth metrics/KPIs (CAC, LTV, conversion, churn, payback period) and report on them regularly to leadership.
	Build and own the growth roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on impact and effort.
	Establish SOPs, dashboards, and repeatable playbooks for growth activities as the function matures.
	Partner cross-functionally with product, marketing, and operations to align growth initiatives with business priorities.
	Lead experiments (A/B testing, cohort analysis) to optimize marketing funnels, conversion rates, and customer lifetime value.
	Manage growth-related budgets and vendor/tool relationships (analytics, CRM, marketing automation, etc.).

Growth Manager Job at Prestigious Consulting




        
    

        
        Prestigious Consulting is a professional HR consultancy firm. We focus on improving organizational performance through strategic people & process management.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Growth Manager

Job Location: Remote

Summary


	We're hiring a Growth Manager to own customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth from theground up.
	This is a hands-on, individual contributor to builder role: you'll design and run the growth strategy, then build out the team and processes to scale it as the company grows.


Job Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Own the end to end growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue expansion.
	Design, launch, and iterate on growth experiments (paid, lifecycle, referral, partnerships, content) using a test and learn approach.
	Define and track the core growth metrics/KPIs (CAC, LTV, conversion, churn, payback period) and report on them regularly to leadership.
	Build and own the growth roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on impact and effort.
	Establish SOPs, dashboards, and repeatable playbooks for growth activities as the function matures.
	Partner cross-functionally with product, marketing, and operations to align growth initiatives with business priorities.
	Lead experiments (A/B testing, cohort analysis) to optimize marketing funnels, conversion rates, and customer lifetime value.
	Manage growth-related budgets and vendor/tool relationships (analytics, CRM, marketing automation, etc.).


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience; MBA or advanced analytics background a plus.
	5-8 years of experience in growth, marketing, or product roles, with a proven track record in fintech, e-commerce, or logistics.
	Track record of owning and hitting growth or revenue targets in a fast-paced environment.
	Strong analytical skills - comfortable with data, experimentation design, and translating numbers into decisions.
	Experience with growth/marketing tooling (analytics platforms, CRM, A/B testing, automation tools).


What we are looking for (Mindset):


	Genuine ownership mindset - you treat the function as if it were your own business, not a set of assigned tasks.
	Builder mentality - comfortable creating structure, SOPs, and process from a blank page rather than inheriting a mature playbook.
	Proven ability to work independently with minimal oversight and make sound judgment calls in ambiguous situations.
	Startup or high-growth company experience strongly preferred - comfortable with fast pace, limited resources, and shifting priorities.
